from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib,re
root=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_month_headline_v1')
def now(): return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
protocol=readj(root/'protocol.json')
assert protocol['budget']['official_query']==1
query=readj(root/'实际唯一官方查询原结果.json')
url='https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896222.html'
assert url in query['raw_result']
receipt_path=root/'一个不同当期解读原载体首次GET回执.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists(),'已有实际回执，禁止重启请求'
source=root/'sources/2019M07_官方解读.html'
source.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
receipt={'started_at':now(),'url':url,'method':'GET','attempt':1,'registration_sha256':sha(root/'protocol.json'),'public_source':True,'authentication':0,'retry':False,'scope':'2019M07当期官方解读；非完整原报告的公布钟替代证据','status':'STARTED_FIRST_AND_ONLY_GET'}
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
try:
    response=requests.get(url,timeout=(12,30),allow_redirects=True)
    receipt.update({'completed_at':now(),'status_code':response.status_code,'final_url':response.url,'redirect_urls':[r.url for r in response.history],'redirect_statuses':[r.status_code for r in response.history]})
    response.raise_for_status()
    source.write_bytes(response.content)
    response.encoding=response.apparent_encoding or 'utf-8'
    soup=BeautifulSoup(response.text,'html.parser')
    headings=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in soup.find_all(['h1','h2'])]
    all_text=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True)
    own_clock=re.findall(r'2019[/.-]0?8[/.-]27\s+09:30',all_text)
    links=[]
    for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True):
        absolute=urljoin(response.url,a['href'])
        if urlparse(absolute).scheme in ('http','https'):
            links.append({'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'url':absolute})
    article=soup.select_one('.TRS_Editor') or soup.select_one('.content') or soup.body
    article_text=article.get_text('\n',strip=True) if article else ''
    required=['2019年7月份','同比增长2.6%','1—7月份累计利润同比下降1.7%','资产处置收益','原油价格回落','销售回暖','同期基数较低','投资收益大幅增加']
    compact=re.sub(r'\s+','',all_text)
    matches={x:x in compact for x in required}
    parse={'parsed_at':now(),'source_url':url,'source_sha256':sha(source),'headings':headings,'own_clock_candidates':own_clock,'own_clock_is_full_report_clock':False,'required_original_body_facts':matches,'full_original_financial_and_efficiency_tables_found':bool('应收票据及应收账款' in compact and '产成品存货周转天数' in compact and len(soup.find_all('table'))>=2),'all_real_links':links,'article_text':article_text,'all_visible_text':all_text,'source_attributed_cause_status':'OFFICIAL_EXPLANATION_NOT_IDENTIFIED_CAUSAL_STOCK_EFFECT','binding_full_original_quantities_to_interpretation_clock_allowed':False,'future_stock_labels':0,'model_fits':0}
    (root/'当期官方解释原段与全部真实链接.json').write_text(json.dumps(parse,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    receipt.update({'status':'GET_COMPLETED_ORIGINAL_INTERPRETATION_NOT_FULL_REPORT','source':source.as_posix(),'source_sha256':sha(source),'bytes':len(response.content),'required_original_body_facts':matches,'links_count':len(links)})
except Exception as exc:
    receipt.update({'completed_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(exc).__name__,'error':str(exc)})
finally:
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
if receipt['status'].startswith('GET_COMPLETED'):
    print(json.dumps({'own_clock':own_clock,'headings':headings,'links_with_target_period':[a for a in links if '2019' in a['text'] or '1—7' in a['text'] or '1-7' in a['text'] or '利润' in a['text']],'article_text':article_text},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
